question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He has experienced __________ abuse.
solution:
The correct answer is: **physical**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options.
 
 
• **Palpable**: Able to be touched or felt. (स्पर्शनीय)
 
• **Visible**: Able to be seen. (दृश्यमान)
 
• **Physical**: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind. (भौतिक)
